SELECT player_id, player_name, SUM(pts) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT game_id) AS games_played
FROM "nba_golden"."dev"."player_game_stats"
WHERE LOWER(TRIM(player_name)) LIKE '%totally imaginary person%'
  AND played = 1
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', game_date) AS INTEGER) = 2017
GROUP BY player_id, player_name
LIMIT 500
